newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June electricity demand up 2.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June electricity demand up 2.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's electricity demand in June grew 2.8 percent from a year earlier to 61.2 billion kilowatt hours (kWh) amid brisk demand from the manufacturing sector, an industry group said on Thursday.

Large-lot industrial demand for the month rose 4.4 percent from a year ago to 23 billion kWh, reflecting robust demand from steelmakers and electric machinery manufacturers, the Federation of Electric Power Companies said.
On the other hand, household demand totalled 15.2 billion kWh, up a scant 0.5 percent from the same period a year ago, the federation said.
